get_current_time.rationale: The tool only says it will `Get current time in a specific timezone` using an IANA `timezone`. This is read-only time calculation data, not non-public user data, attacker-controlled content, a delivery channel to an attacker-readable destination, or host code execution. The annotations also advertise `readOnlyHint`: true and `openWorldHint`: false.

convert_time.rationale: The tool only says it will `Convert time between timezones` from a `source_timezone` and `time` to a `target_timezone`. This is a read-only conversion, not access to non-public data, attacker-controlled content, a write or send to any destination, or host code execution. The annotations also advertise `readOnlyHint`: true and `openWorldHint`: false.
